name: Entry
motion_direction: Two quiet heel-to-toe steps. Natural alternating arm swing. No camera trick substitutes for walking.

name: Attention
motion_direction: Ease to a stop; small torso/head orientation toward a sound. Hold planted support foot.

name: Cuff
motion_direction: Right fingers pinch and release left cuff. Maintain coherent wrist/finger anatomy and face identity.

name: Reaction
motion_direction: Brief light fault in the environment. Head leads a small defensive turn; body weight transfers plausibly.

name: Sidestep
motion_direction: Grounded lateral evasive step with bent knees. Cloth follows torso motion; sparks/debris move independently.

name: Recover
motion_direction: Recover from lateral stance without foot skating. Lower the shielding arm and let jacket settle.

name: Resolve
motion_direction: Controlled three-quarter upper-body settling and a small head turn toward lens. No face shape changes.

name: Eye contact
motion_direction: Subtle breathing and a natural blink; calm direct gaze. Let the live action finish before the brand cut.

name: Brand
motion_direction: Completed 3.6s crown/type reveal, restrained sheen/settling, readable hold and fade, with original stereo sting.
